payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how audio and text sequences are combined in their RNN model.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to encode audio and text data simultaneously.
An attention mechanism is applied to focus on specific parts of the text transcript that contain strong emotional information, conditioned on the audio data.
The final audio encoding vector is used as a context vector to calculate similarity scores with the text-RNN's hidden states, generating an attention-application vector.
